# Shared Types (@vida/types) — Vida Platform

# Auto-read by Claude when editing files in this directory.

# Generated by /layer-docs · refresh: /layer-docs --refresh

## What this layer is

TypeScript type definitions — one file per domain — that every other package imports as the shared data contract. Runtime footprint is deliberately tiny: `APP_NAME`, `MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES`, and the **canonical enum tuples** (DB-9) — plain `as const` string arrays, no `zod`, no other deps.

## Pattern in use

- Domain entities extend `SyncableEntity` (id + timestamps + `_sync_*`); child rows that aren't independently synced extend `SyncMetadata` directly.
- **Enums are `as const` tuples, with the union type DERIVED from the tuple** (DB-9, ADR-002 §2.3): `export const STATUS = ['not_started', …] as const` + `export type Status = (typeof STATUS)[number]`. Never a bare union, never TS `enum`. The tuple is the single canonical source: `@vida/core` wraps it as `z.enum(STATUS)` (the canonical validator) and the SQL `CHECK` list is sourced from it — tuple ≡ union ≡ validator ≡ CHECK, enforced by `packages/core/src/validators/enum-parity.test.ts`. Const name = SCREAMING_SNAKE of the type name.
- Encrypted fields are flagged with a `/** @encrypted */` JSDoc tag above the field.

## Naming

- Files: lowercase domain name (`finance.ts`, `task.ts`); sub-entities under `entities/`.
- Types: PascalCase interfaces and union aliases.

## Organization

- One file per domain; `index.ts` is the barrel that re-exports everything.
- Cross-file references use `import type { ... }` (type-only imports).

## Do not

- `notes.ts` and `models.ts` are empty placeholders — use `note.ts` and the per-domain files; don't revive the empties.

## Key files

- common.ts: primitives (`Id`, `Timestamp`, `Money` cents, `BasisPoints`) + shared enums.
- sync.ts: `SyncMetadata`, `SyncableEntity`, `Syncable<T>`, sync blob wire format.
- index.ts: barrel export — add new domain files here.
